findings.title: SKILL.md:53 standing-rules row: the code cell contradicts the row's own rule cell for the no---paths case, and there is no cell for a declared-but-empty --paths file
findings.evidence: SKILL.md:53 (rule cell says 'with no --paths the code is RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH', code cell says RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT); measured: positive/old/no-paths -> RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH exit 3; positive/old/paths-empty-file -> RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT exit 3 with detail '<no --paths given: content identity is not checkable>' although --paths WAS given
findings.counter_blind_spot: the counter's cell arm builds only the --paths fixture, so it reads ok; its codes arm is satisfied because both tokens are in CODES
findings.recommended_fix: amend the rule cell to state the three-way truth, and add a table row whose first cell does not start with 'a verdict receipt names another revision' (the counter matches that prefix and takes the first hit)
findings.staged_fix_reason: SKILL.md byte changes are the L1's to install and must be re-keyed under rekey-r57-<c0> in wave 3

findings.title: the C2 counter's mutants arm is dead at every committed revision: mutants.json is untracked, so C2_R57_PASS=false total=3 at C0 and at the wave-1 commit
findings.evidence: measure.py reads MUTANTS_PATH via show(lane, rev, ...) at the measured revision; git ls-tree -r ca75c26 -- .ufo/evidence/round-57 lists only coldread-referent-r56.md (same at 06e9849); counter output 'shortfall mutants=3', 'mutants: mutants.json unavailable or pin mismatch', 'C2_R57_PASS=false total=3'

findings.staged_fix_reason: the install is the L1's, and the staged copies already exist under the wave-1 seat's stage/ tree

findings.title: the committed drift row does not discriminate 'the path was added' from 'the path's bytes changed'; a mutant that breaks content-identity on an existing surface survives all three rows
findings.evidence: the drift surface corpus/lessons/round-56-verifier-spotcheck.md is MISSING at receipt rev c34e2b1 and EXISTS at certified rev 5e35699 (git cat-file -e on both); mutant M4 (drifted_paths returns only paths added between revs) leaves 'REGISTRY_CHECK: held=3/3 superseded=0' while wrongly accepting a same-path-different-bytes receipt (PASS rc=0 where the pristine gate gives RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT rc=3); positive control M1 is killed by the same method (held=2/3); mutant M6 (added-only inverted) is killed (held=2/3)
findings.counter_blind_spot: the counter's cell arm DOES catch M4 (its fixture is a same-path byte change: M4 -> emitted=[] exit=0 -> standing_cell=WRONG:fixture); the gap is in the registry ROW set, not in the counter
findings.recommended_fix: re-make the drift fixture over a surface whose bytes differ between two revs where it exists at both (no path in corpus/ differs in bytes between c34e2b1 and 5e35699 while existing at both - measured) and add a registry row for the added-file case
findings.staged_fix_reason: a new fixture requires a content commit by the L1's installer

findings.title: registry-check validates the `source` field's shape only; it never resolves the revision nor checks that the cited line means what the row asserts
findings.evidence: repointing receipt-gate-content-drift's source to tools/receipt-revision-gate.py@5e35699...:1 (not the drift branch) leaves held=3/3 rc=0; registry-check.py:108 SOURCE_RE = ^[^@]+@[0-9a-f]{7,40}:[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?$
findings.note: the three C0 rows' pins are correct today (verified at 5e35699: :220 is the verdict return, :149-152 is the drift branch, :190-194 is the certified-resolution/return-2 block); this is a lane-wide property of registry-check, recorded as residual risk not as a defect of the C0 rows

findings.title: SKILL.md:1547's scratch cell omits the /tmp fallback clause that the registry's own scratch_root cell states
findings.evidence: with TMPDIR set to a non-existent directory: tempfile.gettempdir() -> /tmp, the selftest prints GATE_SELFTEST: 19/19 pass and exits 0, and grep -c 'could-not-evaluate' over the output is 0; the registry's receipt-revision-gate-selftest scratch_root cell states the fallback and that the round-55 scratch-root contract is not implemented by this frozen instrument
findings.recommended_fix: add the fallback clause to the scratch cell in the same re-key pass; the gate itself is frozen and correctly documented in the registry
